title: Eva Strong
creator: CrossFit
description: A partner workout: 5 rounds of 24 double-unders each, 19 toes-to-bars shared, 2 clean and jerks at 205/135 lb shared and a 400 m run together. Honours Eva Mireles, the teacher killed shielding her students in the 2022 Robb Elementary shooting in Uvalde, Texas; the reps mark the date and the 19 children lost. Solo: do everything as written.
